responsibility: Implements the language-level M2EXCEPTION module by mapping the current RTExceptions exception block state to the Modula-2 exception enumeration and by reporting whether execution is presently in an exceptional state. It is the thin language-facing adapter over RTExceptions that initializes a base exception block and exposes exception identity to user code, rather than installing handlers or formatting diagnostics itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the GM2EXCEPTION pair: it translates RTExceptions state into the Modula-2 exception enum, tests whether an exception is active, and initializes the base exception block, whereas GM2EXCEPTION.h only defines the enum and query prototypes.
